_schema.tickers: map of ticker id -> focus object

focus.focus: one specific, concrete sentence on what investors are watching/debating for this name right now - a number, a date, a named risk, not a generic theme
focus.source: publication, analyst note, or filing - required
focus.as_of: YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the source material

META.focus: Meta reports Q3 earnings Oct 21 after the bell; the live debate is 2027 capex guidance (first time given) — Evercore's Mahaney expects it above consensus, forcing 2027 EPS cuts.

NVDA.focus: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 gross margin to 74%, but warned Q4 drops to 71-72% as HBM/memory costs rise faster than expected — Nov 17 print tests whether margin pressure hits early.
NVDA.source: Nvidia Q2 FY27 earnings call, Aug 26, 2026

AAPL.focus: Apple guided Dec-qtr (FQ4'26) revenue to +9-11% YoY ($111.7-113.7B) despite 'significantly greater' iPhone/Mac/iPad supply constraints; Nov 2 print tests whether iPhone 18 demand overcomes it
AAPL.source: Apple FQ3'26 earnings call guidance; MacRumors, Oct 6

MSFT.focus: Azure guided 44-45% Q1 FY27 revenue growth (vs ~41% street consensus) for the Oct 28 print, against quarterly capex seen topping $50B — bulls see upside beat, bears see margin drag.

GOOGL.focus: Alphabet reports Q3 earnings Oct 28; debate is whether it raises FY27 capex guidance again after lifting FY26 to $195-205B, testing Cloud's $514B backlog against Q2's negative free cash flow.

AMZN.focus: AWS grew 37% YoY in Q2, its fastest pace in 18 quarters; Oct 29 Q3 print tests if that holds against the raised $220B 2026 capex guide Jassy says still won't meet AI demand

AMD.focus: Q3 print due Nov 3: AMD guided ~$13B revenue (41% YoY) and 56% gross margin — after a 140% YTD run, bar is whether MI400/Helios ramp lets data center beat that number
AMD.source: AMD Q2 2026 guidance; TD Cowen note, Oct 19, 2026

AVGO.focus: GF Securities flagged a ~3-week slip in Google's TPU v9 tape-out (yield issues on interconnect substrate); debate is whether this dents Broadcom's $115B FY27 AI revenue guide, even as AVGO rose 3% on the read-through.
AVGO.source: GF Securities note, Oct 13 (reported via Seeking Alpha/24/7 Wall St, Oct 19)

INTC.focus: Q3 print (Oct 29) hinges on non-GAAP gross margin hitting guided ~42%; JPMorgan flags each quarterly rise has been smaller than the last, questioning if foundry margin recovery is accelerating.

TSM.focus: Q3 gross margin hit 66.4%, inside TSMC's own guided range for the first time in 2026 — first sign overseas fab dilution isn't worsening even as capex holds at $60-64B and 2nm ramps.

ASML.focus: ASML stopped reporting quarterly bookings (last: €13.2bn, Q4'25); CFO now flags non-current contract liabilities, which jumped to €9.3bn in Q3'26, as the new order-intake proxy.

MU.focus: CXMT unveiled a 4F² DRAM architecture (30-50% denser) and plans a server DDR5 chip by year-end 2026, pulling MU ~5% lower Oct 13 on oversupply/pricing fears — even as Micron's HBM stays sold out through 2027.

MRVL.focus: Google's TPU v9 tape-out slipped to Q2'27 (yields ~45-50%, ship now Q1'28); GF Securities says this doesn't dent Marvell's ASIC role — the key swing factor for FY28 custom-silicon revenue growth.

9988.focus: Can Alibaba Cloud sustain 45% growth (22-qtr high) and 35% AI-product mix into the Nov 24 print, or does AI capex (GAAP profit -75% YoY) justify JPMorgan's Oct 12 cut to $200 target?

0700.focus: Ahead of Nov 18 Q3 print, UBS/GF Securities see ~CNY16bn AI opex cutting adjusted operating profit 2-4% YoY despite 7-9% revenue growth and 18% ad growth — margin erosion vs AI payoff is the live debate.

3690.focus: Nov 27 Q3 print is the test: food-delivery profit/order hit RMB0.20-0.30 in Sept (73M+ daily orders), but management guided unit economics to weaken sequentially on subsidy/marketing costs even as YoY improves.

9618.focus: Whether JD Retail revenue turns positive YoY in Q3 as management guided, after -2.9% YoY in Q2; print due Nov 12, 2026. Food-delivery losses already narrowed >50% YoY in Q2.

6181.focus: Citi cut Laopu TP to HK$400 (from HK$507, Buy kept) on Oct 12, flagging Q3e net profit -12% QoQ to ~589m yuan even as revenue +9% QoQ to 3.6bn yuan — margin squeeze as buyers wait out falling gold prices.
